hook.name: ExponentialLiquidityHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that creates Uniswap v4 pools for newly deployed ERC20 pack tokens, distributing liquidity across exponentially spaced tick ranges. In afterSwap, it enforces whole-token sales, takes a 1% protocol fee via delta return, and when the full bonding curve supply is sold, removes all liquidity and transfers collected base tokens to a PackERC20 contract to enable Chainlink VRF-based pack opening.
